match:
Mechanical Design Engineer
Honda Atlas Cars

output.summary: Component design for passenger vehicle assemblies.
output.responsibilities_text: Produce 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings for vehicle components. Apply GD&T standards to drawings and review supplier submissions. Support design validation, tolerance stack-up analysis and DFM reviews. Work with the production and quality teams to resolve manufacturing issues. Contribute to cost reduction and part localisation projects.

qualification.quoted_text: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from an HEC-recognised university.

experience.quoted_text: 2-4 years of relevant experience in automotive, manufacturing or product design.

age.quoted_text: Applicants should be between 22 and 30 years of age.
